name: Liminal space

influenced_by: found/stock photography of empty institutional spaces

places: empty malls, motel hallways, pool rooms — generic transitional spaces
garments: not a fashion look — a photography/image aesthetic

media.title: The Backrooms (4chan creepypasta, 2019)
media.note: the specific post that popularized the "liminal space" feeling as internet horror

reacts_against: nothing stylistically — it's built from the uncanny feeling of ordinary transitional spaces (hallways, escalators) emptied of the people that normally justify them.

wiki_facts.other_names: Liminality, Liminalcore, Liminal aesthetic, Anemoiacore, Liminal Horror
wiki_facts.key_colours: Cream yellow, typical building colors, black and grey for shadows
wiki_facts.key_values: Uncanniness, surreality, nostalgia, familiarity, discomfort, comfort

findings: mostly muted — about 82% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from the Aesthetics Wiki images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
